details: This package is a modified WhatsApp/Baileys library that covertly enrols the account that installs it into two hardcoded WhatsApp channels. When a socket is created, lib/Socket/newsletter.js schedules a timer that fires 90 seconds later and issues a subscribe ("follow") request for newsletter ID 120363404901093286@newsletter, then a second follow for 120363419564423145@newsletter five seconds after that; both calls are wrapped in empty catch blocks so the outcome is invisible to the host application. The channel IDs are not written as plain strings - they are assembled at runtime from decimal character-code arrays, and the channel name "SANKANIME" is built the same way. The package also hardcodes the same channel as a default annotation on media messages in lib/Utils/messages.js, so uploaded media is tagged with the author's channel reference. The 90-second delay keeps the follow requests clear of the initial connection/require phase. The package performs no credential, token or file access - the preinstall hook only checks the Node.js major version - and all requests go to the standard WhatsApp endpoint. The unwanted behaviour is the unsolicited channel subscription and message tagging performed on the installer's account without consent. Indicators: WhatsApp newsletter IDs 120363404901093286@newsletter and 120363419564423145@newsletter, channel name "SANKANIME", hardcoded in lib/Socket/newsletter.js and lib/Utils/messages.js.
